interaction_phrase: received two grants from Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA)
occurrence_sentence: QuEra Computing, the leader in neutral-atom quantum computers, today announced that it has received two grants from Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) as part of the Imagining Practical Applications for a Quantum Tomorrow (IMPAQT) program to advance the state-of-the-art in quantum algorithms and application development.
